title: Design System: Basic — The Catalogue Page

primary.note: Injected per request from the merchant's ColorTheme preset via libs/theme/src/merchant-bridge.ts; the theme owns no hex. Also the ring by mapMerchantColors. Flat fields only: .plate, active .index-tab / page stub, .chip on, one primary Button per view.

primary-foreground.note: Chosen white/near-black by contrast in the merchant bridge; SHOP NOW inverts it as a field on the plate.

background.note: Aliased as --paper; the page, the masthead, the index strip.

card.note: Aliased as --cell; every entry and cell in a .ruled grid or .rail, chips, page stubs, image beds. Equals paper on light presets, +4% on dark.

foreground.note: Aliased as --ink; all text, the default stamp field, the announcement band.

border.note: Aliased as --rule; every 1px line: ruled-grid gaps and frames, running heads, masthead base, drawer rules, chip borders.

faint.note: Hover wash on index tabs, chips and rail arrows.

accent.note: mapMerchantColors: the shell hover surface (ghost buttons, menu items, social squares), foreground text; a tonal step, never a hue.

secondary.note: mapMerchantColors: the shell secondary button surface, foreground text.

muted.note: At 50%: the search field bed; the cover stage bed while its image loads.

muted-foreground.note: Facts: .cat-no, counts, del prices, city · since, footer heads, facet legends; AA-guarded by the bridge.

sale.note: The preset's error role via the bridge; the SALE / SAVE N% stamp only.

success.note: The price-flash flood and ADDED print; "In stock" text in the buy box. .stamp-success is declared but unused (not canonized).

destructive.note: Text-only via shared primitives: field errors, logout row.

display.purpose: The store's name on the cover plate: Sofia Sans Extra Condensed 800 caps, 3rem → 3.75rem → clamp(3.5rem,6vw,6rem), line-height 0.9; footer name at 1.875rem in 700.

headline.purpose: Every section title (.running-head-title): 700 caps 1.75rem → 2.25rem at lg, line-height 1, +0.01em; prose h2/h3 at 1.75 / 1.375rem.

title.purpose: Drawer titles, order summary head, empty / error titles: .display at 1.25–1.5rem.

price.purpose: Every price (.price): condensed 700, tabular lining, one line — 1.25rem entry, 1rem cart line, 1.5rem subtotal, 2.25rem → 3rem buy box.

index.purpose: Index tabs, page stubs, the language tab, "page x of y": 700 caps 0.875rem +0.04em; tab count at 500 / 70%.

body.purpose: Page copy, facts, inputs, messages: Sofia Sans 400 0.9375rem / 1.5 (prose 1.65 at ≤70ch); buttons 600.

entry-name.purpose: The entry and cart-line name slot: Sofia Sans 500 0.875rem, 2-line clamp, dir=auto; buy-box name 600 at 1.5 → 1.875rem.

label.purpose: Footer column heads, facet legends, SUBTOTAL: Sofia Sans 600 0.75rem +0.025em uppercase print grey.

cat-no.purpose: "No. SKU" (.cat-no): 0.75rem +0.02em tabular print grey, nowrap, maker before it.

shadows.name: elev-sm
shadows.purpose: Flat: every entry, cell, chip, plate and stamp at rest; keeps shared primitives asking for shadow-sm flat.

shadows.name: elev-md
shadows.purpose: The rail's prev / next squares — a floating control.

shadows.name: elev-lg
shadows.purpose: Declared for the shell; referenced by no theme element (not canonized).

shadows.name: elev-overlay
shadows.purpose: Search suggestions list, menus, drawers, toasts (shell shadow-overlay).

motion.name: motion-fast
motion.purpose: Hover colour on index tabs, chips, rail arrows, thumbnails, SHOP NOW opacity.

motion.name: motion-base
motion.purpose: The entry photo cross-fade on hover.

motion.name: motion-slow
motion.purpose: Declared; not referenced by a theme element (not canonized).

motion.name: easing-emphasized
motion.purpose: The price flash (basic-flash, 1.6s): scaleX 0→1 by 12%, hold to 78%, fade to 100%; origin start edge (mirrored in RTL); a still hold under prefers-reduced-motion.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "One Continuous Ruled Catalogue"**

The store is a mail-order catalogue, not a page of cards. Every product is an entry — photo, name, catalogue number and a big condensed price in the same fixed slots — and entries share 1px rules instead of floating: a grid is a ruled spread (`.ruled`), a home group is a ruled rail, the footer is four ruled cells, the cart is ruled lines. The categories are the book's thumb-index, a strip of uppercase condensed tabs under the masthead with the current section printed as a flat field of the merchant primary. The world refuses the default theme's white page of rounded, shadowed cards under a full-bleed slider: here the slider is a ruled stage capped at 40–58vh with numbered page stubs at its bottom-end, and the store's name stands on a primary title block overlapping its bottom-start.

The materials are the preset's paper and ink (`--paper` / `--ink` alias the merchant background and foreground) and the preset's border as the rule. Planes are flat; only floating surfaces (rail arrows, the search list, menus, drawers) lift, with a real offset and blur. Colour is scarce and flat: the merchant primary appears only as a plate — the cover title block, the active index tab, the active page stub, the selected chip, the one primary action per view — never as text or a tint. State is a printed stamp in a fixed slot (SALE, OUT OF STOCK, ONLY N LEFT, ADDED); in stock is silence on entries. Type is a single super-family: Sofia Sans for what explains, Sofia Sans Extra Condensed 700/800 uppercase for what names and for every price, Cairo leading both roles in Arabic. Density is compact (0.9375rem body, 1px gaps), and there is exactly one authored motion: the price cell floods success-green from the start edge and prints ADDED when the bag takes the add.
keyCharacteristics: Entries in ruled grids and rails (`.ruled`, `.rail`): cells on `--cell` separated by 1px of `--rule`; nothing floats, no card radius, no card shadow.
The merchant primary only as `.plate` / active `.index-tab` / active page stub / `.chip` on / the one primary button per view, plus the ring, caret, accent-color and `::selection`.
State as a `.stamp` in a fixed slot: ink stamp by default, `--sale` for SALE, outline for ONLY N LEFT; the buy box prints "In stock" in success text.

Sofia Sans Extra Condensed 700 uppercase (`.display`, `.running-head-title`, `.index-tab`, `.stamp`) and for every price (`.price`, tabular, one line); Sofia Sans 400–600 for names, facts, prose; Cairo first in `:lang(ar)`.
One motion, the price flash (`basic-flash`, 1.6s emphasized ease-out, held then released; a still hold under reduced motion); everything else is a 120–200ms colour / opacity transition.
Square cells and images (0 radius), a hairline softening on controls (0.25rem), stamps at 0.125rem, overlays at 0.5rem.

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: The merchant primary is a flat field (`.plate`, active `.index-tab`, active page stub, `.chip` on, the one primary button per view) or the ring / caret / selection. No primary text, no primary rules, no primary tint, no second primary button in a view.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: State is printed in a fixed slot as a `.stamp`: ink for OUT OF STOCK, `--sale` for SALE, outline for ONLY N LEFT, success for ADDED (the flash). No coloured borders, washes or badges for state; in stock on an entry is silence.

rules.name: The One-Hue Rule
rules.body: Accent and secondary are tonal mixes of paper toward ink; hover is `--faint` (8%) or 90% opacity; the only chroma besides the primary is sale (stamp) and success (flash, in-stock text).

rules.name: The Condensed Voice Rule
rules.body: If it names or prices, it is Sofia Sans Extra Condensed 700 uppercase (Cairo in Arabic) with tabular lining numerals; product names, facts and prose are never condensed, and a price is never Sofia Sans.

rules.name: The Printed Fact Rule
rules.body: Prices come pre-formatted from the API and are never re-formatted; counts, SKUs, dates and phone numbers carry `tabular-nums`; merchant-supplied names sit in `<bdi dir="auto">` and long names break with `overflow-wrap: anywhere`.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px `--rule`; a shadow means the surface is floating over the page (menus, drawers, rail arrows, toasts). Never a shadow on an entry, a cell, a button or a stamp; never a glow or a coloured shadow.

rules.name: The Layering Rule
rules.body: World classes (`.display`, `.price`, `.ruled`, `.plate`, `.index-tab`, `.stamp`, `.chip`, `.running-head`, `.cat-no`, `.flash`, `.scroll-x`, `.prose-basic`) live in `@layer components`, so a Tailwind utility on the same element (`text-xl`, `size-9`, `p-0`) always wins; only the Swiper overrides (`.cover`, `.rail`) stay unlayered because Swiper's CSS is.

dos: **Do** put entries in a `.ruled` grid (2 / 2 / 3 / 4, 1px `--rule` gaps, children on `--cell`) or a `.rail`; keep every entry's slots fixed — photo 1:1, name (2 lines, Sofia Sans 500), `.cat-no`, `.price` beside a `size-9` `.chip` square.
**Do** reserve the merchant primary for flat fields: `.plate`, the active `.index-tab` / page stub, `.chip` on, and one primary `Button` per view; keep SHOP NOW as the inversion on the plate.
**Do** print state as a `.stamp` in its slot (ink; `.stamp-sale`; `.stamp-outline`) and let the price cell `.flash` ADDED on add; leave in stock silent on entries.

**Do** set names, heads, tabs, stamps and every price in Sofia Sans Extra Condensed 700 uppercase with tabular lining numerals (`.display`, `.running-head-title`, `.index-tab`, `.stamp`, `.price`) and explanation in Sofia Sans; wrap merchant strings in `<bdi dir="auto">`.

**Do** separate with 1px rules (`border`, `border-t`, `divide-y`, `.running-head`) and keep planes flat; use `--elev-md` / `--elev-overlay` only on surfaces that float (rail arrows, menus, drawers, the search list).
**Do** keep radii to the scale: 0 on cells / images / plates, 0.25rem on controls and chips, 0.125rem on stamps, 0.5rem on overlays.
**Do** cap the cover stage (4:3 / 40vh, 16:9 / 50vh, 21:9 / 58vh) and let the plate stand alone when the merchant has no image.
**Do** mirror for RTL with logical properties, `rtl:rotate-180` on directional icons, and trust the `:lang(ar)` font swap (Cairo first, letter-spacing 0 on the condensed voice).
donts: **Don't** hard-code hex; every colour is a role variable from the merchant bridge or a declared `color-mix` of `--foreground` / `--background` (`--faint`, the accent / secondary mixes in `mapMerchantColors`).

**Don't** tint or colour state: no primary / sale / success backgrounds wider than a stamp or the flash, no coloured borders, no opacity fades beyond the 50% greyscale sold-out photo, the 50% disabled square and the listing's 60% while loading.
**Don't** float an entry, cell, button or stamp: no card shadows, no hover lift, no glows; hover is `--faint`, the accent wash or 90% opacity.

**Don't** add a second motion: `basic-flash` (1.6s, `--easing-emphasized`, start-edge flood, held then released; a still hold under `prefers-reduced-motion`) is the theme's only keyframe; everything else is a ≤200ms transition.
**Don't** set a price, a head or a tab in Sofia Sans, or a product name / fact / prose in the condensed face; don't request display weights below 700 or set the display in sentence case.
**Don't** put category navigation in the masthead — it is the index strip; don't give the cover a full-bleed or uncapped slider.
**Don't** round cells or images, add radii above 0.25rem to controls, or draw a border in anything but `--rule` (the outline stamp's ink inset and the dashed `.chip-off` are the only exceptions).
